title: Research and investigation.
officialText:
When required by the commissioner, sufficient technical data shall be submitted to the
commissioner to substantiate the proposed use of any material. If it is determined that the evidence submitted is satisfactory proof
of performance for the use intended, the commissioner shall approve the use of the material subject to the requirements of this code.
